He’s a real-deal, bona fide Hollywood star—which is why it may be surprising that he lent his talent to a decidedly anti-communist, pro-Christian movie put out by a conservative media company. (James Devaney/GC Images) The ‘West Wing’ actor stars in a new anti-communist movie written by Ben Shapiro. ‘I’m not an ideologue,’ he tells Suzy Weiss. By Suzy Weiss 11.17.26 — Culture and Ideas This article is part of The Zeitgeist . Follow to get everything we publish on ideas, arts, entertainment, dating, faith and more. FOLLOW BUNDLE --:-- --:-- Upgrade to Listen Produced by ElevenLabs using AI narration 13 37 READ IN APP READ IN APP Like most other people who saw it, I assume, when I watched the trailer for the new movie Confession , I thought, Is that Rob Lowe? 
 It is indeed Rob Lowe, of West Wing fame. He plays Alexei Abramov, a professor in late 1930s Russia who is arrested on charges of counterrevolutionary activities during the Great Purge, then interrogated by a former student, played by James Franco. The film was written by Ben Shapiro, and released by his media company, The Daily Wire. At a Free Press screening of the film, Shapiro pointed out that it took four hours to transform the perennially tanned and coiffed Rob Lowe into a grizzled, alcoholic prisoner suffering under Stalin’s boot.
